purpose: Run a separately labeled interface-corrected OpenRouter-mediated GPT-5.4 public-development follow-up without altering the failed v1 run or the original official-API protocol.

amendment.interpretation: V1 retained its no-endpoint STOP outcome. V2 changes only the output-token parameter after the live endpoint capability list showed that the direct OpenAI endpoint accepts max_tokens, not max_completion_tokens. V2 remains post-protocol public-development evidence.

design.interpretation: Descriptive post-transport-failure interface revision on the frozen public-development split.
design.structured_output_policy: Require strict JSON Schema, route only to the OpenAI provider endpoint, disable provider fallbacks, cap acceptable endpoint prices, and apply deterministic local schema and semantic validation.
design.full_phase_rule: After GO, re-execute all 100 public-development instances as a separate full phase; pilot outputs are not substituted into the full result.
design.sampling_parameters: No temperature, top_p, or seed parameter is sent; reasoning effort is fixed at medium.
design.max_output_budget_rule: The 3,072-token maximum and $2.50/$15 per-million input/output price ceiling are fixed before v2 inference; the conservative pilot-plus-full upper bound remains below the authorized lane cap.
design.repeatability_limit: One no-retry pass per phase does not estimate within-model stochastic variance. Request timestamps, returned model and provider identifiers, request hashes, final-response hashes, and usage are retained.

dataset.source: deterministically rebuilt v1 public dev split

pilot.selection_rule: the same lexicographically first pair_id in each of the six benchmark families fixed by the base protocol and retained from v1
pilot.go_rule: Execute the full 100-item run iff the pilot has zero transport failures and at least 10 of 12 decisions pass JSON-schema and semantic validation. Accuracy and action distribution do not affect GO/STOP.

budget.actual_cost_rule: Compute from host-reported tokens and the frozen price ceiling, and separately read back the OpenRouter credit balance and key usage.

reporting.promotion_rule: A validated full run may be reported only as an interface-corrected, post-transport-failure, OpenRouter-mediated GPT-5.4 public-development follow-up. It must not be described as the failed v1 lane, the unexecuted official OpenAI API lane, a preregistered study, or held-out generalization.
